messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: sustained packet loss + TCP retransmits detected for inference-prod-usw2a in az1a. error rate rising ~00:02 UTC. auto-pager triggered.

oncall-sre: I’m on it — pulling logs and perf counters now. tagging maya and juan.

maya: seeing gRPC p99 latency jump and client TCP RTOs. connections to g5.2xlarge nodes in az1a intermittently drop.

juan: confirming. netstat shows repeated socket CLOSE_WAIT on 10.0.45.*. kernel counters for tx_dropped incrementing.

alex: quick question — any recent control-plane changes? Route53, NLB, or ENI scale?

oncall-sre: no infra deploys in the last 2 hours per deploy-bot. CloudWatch shows AZ-level network metrics spiking for ENI errors.

maya: customer impact: hosted text-generation region us-west-2 — ~8-12% of requests are failing with upstream econnreset and some are stuck waiting for KV cache leading to 4-8s extra latency. A small subset of traffic pins to az1a due to older sticky sessions.

sam: adding mitigation suggestions: 1) reduce DNS TTL and issue weight-based reroute away from az1a 2) replace instances or drain and reattach 3) increase fallback capacity in az1b.

juan: starting traffic steering. lowering Route53 TTL to 30s and shifting weight:
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZABC123 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"inference-usw2a.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"usw2a-az1b","Weight":80,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"3.12.45.9"}]}}]}'
```

oncall-sre: also temporarily disabling session affinity on the NLB to avoid sticky routing to affected ENIs: set target group attribute 'deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds' to 10 and 'stickiness.enabled' to false.

maya: initiating controlled drain of 3 suspect nodes in az1a (ids i-0abc, i-0def, i-0ghi). will cordon + evict tasks:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-az1a-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-az1a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

alex: monitor customer error rates as you drain; we want to avoid cascading failures. setting alert: hosted-api-errors > 5% sustained triggers page.

juan: small hiccup — Route53 change propagated but we still see ~3% residual failures due to DNS caching at some edge proxies. starting short-lived health proxy on front-tier to force reconnects.

sam: can we confirm whether the root cause is network fabric in AZ or an instance CPU/network driver bug? packet captures?

maya: tcpdump from one affected host shows repeated retransmits and MTU mismatch warnings. also seeing kernel logs about enic resetting. raising a support ticket with cloud provider with trace id 27b3-az1a-net.

oncall-sre: cloud provider acknowledged degraded switch fabric in az1a for a subset of hosts. they recommended steering traffic and replacing instances. ETA for full fabric restoration unknown.

juan: coordinated with infra to spin up replacement nodes in az1b and drain az1a ones. autoscaling policy temporarily bumped desired capacity for the pool in az1b.

maya: customer comms draft for status page: "We are investigating increased request failures in us-west-2 impacting a subset of inference requests due to networking issues in a single availability zone. We are steering traffic and replacing nodes; mitigation is in progress." ping @support to publish.

sam: support notified and asked to include affected customers: accounts with sticky routing in us-west-2 (approx 24 orgs). priority customers marked for direct outreach.

oncall-sre: handoff — I’ve stabilized routing and started node replacements. monitoring. handing to juan for overnight watch. @juan you take over on-call for next 6 hours.

juan: taking handoff. I'll keep TTL low and watch p95/p99 and error budget dashboards. if packet loss > 2% for >15m escalate to infra leads + cloud provider.

maya: logs and artifacts: uploaded tcpdump + kernel logs to S3 s3://redwood-incident-logs/2103056789/ . Incident ticket INC-2103056789 opened.

oncall-sre: closing quick loop: immediate mitigation applied (DNS steer + node replacement). impact reduced from ~12%-> ~1.5% failures in 35m. remaining work: provider fabric remediation + replace remaining affected hosts.

juan: noted. will post any provider updates and reopen paging if degradation recurs. :white_check_mark:
